title: DIMMED FEED LINES LOSE THEIR PLATE
why: The HUD spec of 2026-10-15 (step 10): the feed should read as a quiet column. A line dimmed to 35 percent kept its dark plate, so ten dimmed lines were ten dark boxes. A line now loses its plate as it dims (over the same second), leaving its words at 35 percent and its glyph in the kind colour, and in a fight the aged lines dim to 20 percent.
now: Dimmed feed lines now lose their plate, and dim further in a fight.

edits.replacement:
FEEDBOX.on=0; FEEDBOX.rows=[];
  try{ FEEDDIM=(typeof inCombatNow==='function'&&inCombatNow())?0.20:FEED.dim; }catch(_fdm){ FEEDDIM=FEED.dim; }   // v16.xx (feed4): the aged lines dim further in a fight
